description: This file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class implementing OAuth2 authorization code management, including persisting, revoking, and checking the revocation status of authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Implements the OAuth2 authorization code storage and management by extending BaseDao and implementing AuthCodeRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new authorization code entity to the database, mapping properties from the OAuth2 AuthCodeEntityInterface.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks the specified authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the authorization code has been revoked or does not exist.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
